rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Yellow Dragon, the Yellow Emperor animal manifestation embodying earth in Chinese tradition. Native square PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: one yellow dragon head, two eyes, close cropped coiling dragon neck; body and limbs remain outside image; no invented horns, wings, armour, additional faces or jewels; yellow scales are editorial rendering of named dragon form [yellow-dragon-c01, yellow-dragon-c03]
MOMENT: RISE from the dark earth into the close viewer plane, head bending down in overwhelming reverent presence, not an evil monster
POWER: no earthquake, earth-splitting, breath weapon or supernatural glow is asserted; earth domain represented by soil held against yellow neck, displaced ordinary dust from emergence only [yellow-dragon-c02, yellow-dragon-c03]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortened framing; no invented gigantic size
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single slanting warm sunset shaft, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light
SURFACE: matte yellow-ochre scale texture and dry dark soil
SETTING: earth-coloured ground at Chengji, location of recorded appearance, no invented palace [yellow-dragon-c06]
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented character; never cute, calm or decorative. The creature itself dominates and remains striking at 200 pixels.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, coloured magic mist or energy ribbons. Bracketed claim IDs are instructions, never visible text.
CORRECTION: NO whiskers, NO beard, NO mane, NO hair, NO horns, NO ears, NO dorsal crest or spikes. Head has only yellow scales, two eyes, nasal openings and a broad elongated dragon muzzle with closed mouth. Close head-and-coiling-neck crop, limbs absent from frame. Maintain commanding reverent dragon emergence through ordinary soil, no invented earthquake or glow.
